reason: My spreadsheet already works and I know where every baht went. The statement import sounds useful, but I would have to set up a Shortcut on my phone and trust a new app with my card statement before I see any gain.
objection: Why would I hand my card statement and bank slips to an app I have never used, when I already keep a spreadsheet that works?
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial imported my own statement PDF correctly, with the categories right, in under five minutes, and the Shortcut setup was clearly shorter than retyping a month.
